name: Wei Jian Hao
bio:
Wei Jian Hao's fascination with engines began in his childhood, tinkering with his grandfather's old scooter. This early exposure ignited a passion that led him to pursue vocational training in mechanical engineering. After graduating at the top of his class, he landed an apprenticeship at a local performance shop specializing in aftermarket modifications for street cars. Wei's meticulous nature and problem-solving abilities quickly made him an asset. 

He transitioned to motorsport after attending a Formula 4 race at the Sepang International Circuit. The precision and speed captivated him, and he applied for a role at Blau Motorsport. Wei believes in a hands-on approach, meticulously checking every component and constantly seeking ways to improve performance through innovative solutions. His dedication to achieving perfection sets him apart, often pushing him to work late to ensure every detail is addressed.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed sides with slightly longer, textured hair on top, styled with a matte finish.
physical.description: Wei is of average height, with a lean build honed from years of working with heavy machinery.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting a new task.
Keeps a small notebook filled with sketches and diagrams of engine components.
Insists on cleaning his tools with meticulous care after each use.
